revenue.quote: Microsoft says GitHub now has a $1B ARR, 90M active users

note: GitHub Copilot cloud sandboxes are not an independent company: they are a feature within GitHub Copilot, itself a product of GitHub, Inc., a wholly-owned Microsoft subsidiary since the 2018 acquisition (~$7.5B all-stock). There is no separate cap table, funding round, or standalone revenue figure for Copilot or for the cloud-sandboxes feature; the $1B ARR figure is for all of GitHub (2022), not Copilot or sandboxes alone. The underlying execution platform is Microsoft's Azure Container Apps Sandboxes. Cloud sandboxing entered public preview 2026-06-02 and is billed separately from Copilot AI credits.
